summary: The hardest part of someone changing the plan may be how quickly it turns you back into the person who had to adjust after everyone else decided.
body: The hardest part of someone changing the plan may be how quickly it turns you back into the person who had to adjust after everyone else decided. When Uranus opposes Chiron, another person's departure, changed availability, new boundary, or sudden decision can land on a history of being the one expected to absorb disruption without much say. That history can make the current change feel like abandonment before you know what is still available. Get specific about what changed, what did not, and what you need now. Another person's change does not automatically require you to carry the entire transition again.
